SupportAddedChaosDamage.name: Added Chaos Damage
SupportAddedChaosDamage.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportAwakenedAddedChaosDamage.name: Awakened Added Chaos Damage
SupportAwakenedAddedChaosDamage.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportAddedLightningDamage.name: Added Lightning Damage
SupportAddedLightningDamage.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportAwakenedAddedLightningDamage.name: Awakened Added Lightning Damage
SupportAwakenedAddedLightningDamage.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportArcaneSurge.name: Arcane Surge
SupportArcaneSurge.description: Each supported spell will track how much mana you spend on it, granting a buff when the total mana spent reaches a threshold. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, mines or skills with a reservation.

support_arcane_surge_mana_regeneration_r: mod("ArcaneSurgeManaRegen", "MAX", nil, 0, 0, { type = "GlobalEffect", effectType = "Buff", effectName = "Arcane Surge", unscalable = true })
support_arcane_surge_cast_speed_+%: mod("ArcaneSurgeCastSpeed", "MAX", nil, 0, 0, { type = "GlobalEffect", effectType = "Buff", effectName = "Arcane Surge", unscalable = true })

SupportArchmage.name: Archmage
SupportArchmage.description: Supports spell skills that deal damage with hits and have no reservation. Cannot support arcane skills, Brand skills, Orb skills, Vaal skills, or skills used by totems, traps or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

SupportBlasphemy.name: Blasphemy
SupportBlasphemy.description: Supports hex curse skills, turning them into auras that will apply their effect to all enemies in an area around you.

SupportAwakenedBlasphemy.name: Awakened Blasphemy
SupportAwakenedBlasphemy.description: Supports hex curse skills, turning them into auras that will apply their effect to all enemies in an area around you.

SupportBonechill.name: Bonechill
SupportBonechill.description: Supports any skill that can chill enemies or create chilling areas.

SupportCastWhenStunned.name: Cast when Stunned
SupportCastWhenStunned.description: Each supported spell skill will have a chance to be triggered when you are stunned. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

SupportCastWhileChannelling.name: Cast while Channelling
SupportCastWhileChannelling.description: Must support both a channelling skill and a non-channelling spell skill to work. The channelling skill will trigger a spell periodically while channelling. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

SupportCastWhileChannellingTriggered.name: Cast while Channelling
SupportCastWhileChannellingTriggered.description: Must support both a channelling skill and a non-channelling spell skill to work. The channelling skill will trigger a spell periodically while channelling. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

SupportAwakenedCastWhileChannelling.name: Awakened Cast While Channelling
SupportAwakenedCastWhileChannelling.description: Must support both a channelling skill and a non-channelling spell skill to work. The channelling skill will trigger a spell periodically while channelling. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

SupportCastWhileChannellingTriggeredPlus.name: Awakened Cast While Channelling
SupportCastWhileChannellingTriggeredPlus.description: Must support both a channelling skill and a non-channelling spell skill to work. The channelling skill will trigger a spell periodically while channelling. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

SupportCombustion.name: Combustion
SupportCombustion.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportConcentratedEffect.name: Concentrated Effect
SupportConcentratedEffect.description: Supports any skill with an area of effect, regardless of whether that skill deals damage.

SupportControlledDestruction.name: Controlled Destruction
SupportControlledDestruction.description: Supports attack skills, or spell skills that deal damage.

SupportAwakenedControlledDestruction.name: Awakened Controlled Destruction
SupportAwakenedControlledDestruction.description: Supports attack skills, or spell skills that deal damage.

SupportHextouch.name: Hextouch
SupportHextouch.description: Must support both a skill that hits enemies, and a hex curse skill to work. The hex will be applied when enemies are hit by the other skill. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Minions cannot apply hexes this way.

SupportCurseOnHitCurse.name: Hextouch
SupportCurseOnHitCurse.description: Must support both a skill that hits enemies, and a hex curse skill to work. The hex will be applied when enemies are hit by the other skill. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Minions cannot apply hexes this way.

SupportAwakenedHextouch.name: Awakened Hextouch
SupportAwakenedHextouch.description: Must support both a skill that hits enemies, and a hex curse skill to work. The hex will be applied when enemies are hit by the other skill. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Minions cannot apply hexes this way.

SupportCurseOnHitCursePlus.name: Awakened Hextouch
SupportCurseOnHitCursePlus.description: Must support both a skill that hits enemies, and a hex curse skill to work. The hex will be applied when enemies are hit by the other skill. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Minions cannot apply hexes this way.

support_minion_focus_fire_damage_+%_fina: mod("MinionModifier", "LIST", { mod = mod("Damage", "MORE", nil) }, 0, 0, { type = "Condition", var = "EnemyHasDeathmark" })

SignalPrey.name: Signal Prey
SignalPrey.description: Applies a debuff to a specific enemy which signals your minions to consider that enemy to be the Prey. All minions from skills supported by any Predator Support will target that enemy. Only one enemy can be the Prey at a time. This skill cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

SupportDecay.name: Decay
SupportDecay.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportDevour.name: Devour
SupportDevour.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportEfficacy.name: Efficacy
SupportEfficacy.description: Supports any skill that deals damage or has a duration.

SupportElementalFocus.name: Elemental Focus
SupportElementalFocus.description: Supports any skill that hits or burns enemies, or inflicts elemental ailments.

SupportAwakenedElementalFocus.name: Awakened Elemental Focus
SupportAwakenedElementalFocus.description: Supports any skill that hits or burns enemies, or inflicts elemental ailments.

SupportElementalProliferation.name: Elemental Proliferation
SupportElementalProliferation.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies, or could otherwise apply elemental ailments.

SupportEnergyLeech.name: Energy Leech
SupportEnergyLeech.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies, causing those hits to leech energy shield based on damage dealt.

SupportEnlighten.name: Enlighten
SupportEnlighten.description: Supports any skill gem. Once this gem reaches level 2 or above, will apply a cost & reservation multiplier to supported gems. Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.

SupportAwakenedEnlighten.name: Awakened Enlighten
SupportAwakenedEnlighten.description: Supports any skill gem. Once this gem reaches level 2 or above, will apply a cost & reservation multiplier to supported gems. Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.

support_minion_offensive_stance_minion_d: mod("MinionModifier", "LIST", { mod = mod("Damage", "MORE", nil) }, 0, 0, { type = "Condition", var = "FeedingFrenzyActive" })

SupportFocusedChannelling.name: Focused Channelling
SupportFocusedChannelling.description: Supports channelling spells you cast yourself, significantly empowering their damage the longer they are channelled for, while also raising their cost. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

support_focus_channel_cost_+%_final_per_: mod("Cost", "MORE", nil, 0, 0, { type = "Multiplier", var = "ChannellingTime", limit = 100, limitTotal = true })
support_focus_channel_damage_+%_final_pe: mod("Damage", "MORE", nil, 0, 0, { type = "Multiplier", var = "ChannellingTime", limit = 60, limitTotal = true })

SupportFreshMeat.name: Fresh Meat

support_recent_minions_additional_critic: mod("MinionModifier", "LIST", { mod = mod("CritMultiplier", "BASE", nil) }, 0, 0, { type = "Condition", var = "FreshMeatActive" })

baseMods: mod("MinionModifier", "LIST", { mod = mod("Condition:Adrenaline", "FLAG", true) }, 0, 0, { type = "Condition", var = "FreshMeatActive" })

SupportHexBloom.name: Hex Bloom
SupportHexBloom.description: Supports hex curse skills. Hexes from auras or cursed ground cannot transfer.

SupportHighImpactMine.name: High-Impact Mine
SupportHighImpactMine.description: Supports spells, or attacks that use bows or wands. Instead of using that skill, you will throw a mine that will use the skill for you when you detonate it. Mines cannot use channelling skills.

support_remote_mine_2_chance_to_deal_dou: mod("SelfDoubleDamageChance", "BASE", nil, 0, 0, { type = "Limit", limit = 100 }, { type = "GlobalEffect", effectType = "AuraDebuff", effectName = "High-Impact Mine", effectStackVar = "ActiveMineCount" })

SupportIgniteProliferation.name: Ignite Proliferation
SupportIgniteProliferation.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportImmolate.name: Immolate
SupportImmolate.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportImpendingDoom.name: Impending Doom
SupportImpendingDoom.description: Supports hex curse skills, causing them to trigger Doom Blast when the hex ends. Cannot support curse skills which are triggered or applied as an aura.

DoomBlast.name: Doom Blast
DoomBlast.description: Deals chaos damage in an area.

SupportIncreasedAreaOfEffect.name: Increased Area of Effect
SupportIncreasedAreaOfEffect.description: Supports any skill with an area of effect.

SupportAwakenedIncreasedAreaofEffect.name: Awakened Increased Area of Effect
SupportAwakenedIncreasedAreaofEffect.description: Supports any skill with an area of effect.

SupportIncreasedCriticalDamage.name: Increased Critical Damage
SupportIncreasedCriticalDamage.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportIncreasedCriticalStrikes.name: Increased Critical Strikes
SupportIncreasedCriticalStrikes.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportInfusedChannelling.name: Infused Channelling
SupportInfusedChannelling.description: Supports any channelling skill, protecting you from damage while you channel it. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

support_storm_barrier_damage_taken_when_: mod("DamageTakenWhenHit", "MORE", nil, 0, 0, { type = "GlobalEffect", effectType = "Buff", effectName = "Infused Channelling", modCond = "InfusionActive" })

SupportInnervate.name: Innervate
SupportInnervate.description: Supports any skill you use to hit enemies yourself. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines.

support_innervate_minimum_added_lightnin: mod("LightningMin", "BASE", nil, 0, 0, { type = "GlobalEffect", effectType = "Buff", effectName = "Innervation", effectCond = "InnervationActive" })
support_innervate_maximum_added_lightnin: mod("LightningMax", "BASE", nil, 0, 0, { type = "GlobalEffect", effectType = "Buff", effectName = "Innervation", effectCond = "InnervationActive" })

SupportIntensify.name: Intensify
SupportIntensify.description: Supports spell skills that you cast yourself. Cannot support triggered skills, Vaal skills, instant skills, channelling skills, skills with a reservation or which create minions, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines.

support_spell_boost_area_damage_+%_final: mod("Damage", "MORE", nil, ModFlag.Area, 0, { type = "Multiplier", var = "Intensity", limitVar = "IntensityLimit" })

SupportItemRarity.name: Item Rarity
SupportItemRarity.description: Supports any skill that can kill enemies.

SupportKineticInstability.name: Kinetic Instability
SupportKineticInstability.description: Supports Wand Attacks, granting them a chance to trigger Kinetic Flux on kill. Cannot support triggered skills or skills used by things other than you. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

TriggeredSupportKineticInstability.name: Kinetic Flux
TriggeredSupportKineticInstability.description: Gathers kinetic energy into an anomaly at the targeted location, which will explode when enemies are near it, dealing your wand's damage in an area. The anomaly will dissipate after a duration.

SupportLightningPenetration.name: Lightning Penetration
SupportLightningPenetration.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy lightning resistance.

SupportLivingLightning.name: Living Lightning
SupportLivingLightning.description: Supports Skills which cause Damaging Hits, causing them to trigger Summon Living Lightning when dealing lightning damage. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Cannot modify the skills of Minions.

TriggeredSupportLivingLightning.name: Summon Living Lightning
TriggeredSupportLivingLightning.description: Summons Living Lightning Minions, which target nearby enemies with a number of Melee Chaining Attacks before dissipating. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them.

SupportAwakenedLightningPenetration.name: Awakened Lightning Penetration
SupportAwakenedLightningPenetration.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy lightning resistance.

support_minion_defensive_stance_minion_d: mod("MinionModifier", "LIST", { mod = mod("Damage", "MORE", nil) }, bit.band(ModFlag.Hit, ModFlag.Ailment), 0, { type = "Condition", var = "MeatShieldEnemyNearYou" })

SupportOvercharge.name: Overcharge
SupportOvercharge.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportPhysicalToLightning.name: Physical to Lightning
SupportPhysicalToLightning.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportPrismaticBurst.name: Prismatic Burst
SupportPrismaticBurst.description: Supports attacks, causing them to trigger the Prismatic Burst spell. Cannot support triggered attacks or attacks used by things other than you. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

PrismaticBurst.name: Prismatic Burst
PrismaticBurst.description: Chooses an element at random and deals damage of that type in an area. Having higher strength makes it more likely to choose fire, higher dexterity makes it more likely to choose cold, and higher intelligence makes it more likely to choose lightning.

SupportPinpoint.name: Pinpoint
SupportPinpoint.description: Supports projectile spells you cast yourself. Cannot support triggered skills, Vaal skills, instant skills, channelling skills, skills with a reservation or which create minions, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines.

greater_projectile_intensity_projectile_: mod("Damage", "MORE", nil, ModFlag.Projectile, 0, { type = "Multiplier", var = "Intensity" , limitVar = "IntensityLimit" })

SupportPowerChargeOnCritical.name: Power Charge On Critical
SupportPowerChargeOnCritical.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportBlastchainMine.name: Blastchain Mine
SupportBlastchainMine.description: Supports spells, or attacks that use bows or wands. Instead of using that skill, you will throw a mine that will use the skill for you when you detonate it. Mines cannot use channelling skills.

SupportSacredWisps.name: Sacred Wisps
SupportSacredWisps.description: Supports attack skills that can be used with Wands. Cannot support Vaal skills, minion skills, movement skills, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines.

SummonSacredWisp.name: Summon Sacred Wisps
SummonSacredWisp.description: This skill is triggered by supported skills to summon Sacred Wisps which use the triggering skill when you do.

support_sacred_wisps_wisp_additional_%_c: mod("SacredWispsChance", "BASE", 25, nil, nil, { type = "ActorCondition", actor = "enemy", var = "RareOrUnique" })

SupportSacrifice.name: Sacrifice
SupportSacrifice.description: Supports spell skills that hit enemies and have no reservation. Cannot support brand skills, orb skills, channelling skills, arcane skills, Vaal skills or skills used by traps or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

support_sacrifice_sacrifice_%_of_current: mod("Multiplier:SacrificePercent", "BASE", nil, 0, 0, { type = "PercentStat", stat = "LifeUnreserved", percent = 1, actor = "parent" })

SupportSpellblade.name: Spellblade
SupportSpellblade.description: Supports spells that hit enemies. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

SupportSpellCascade.name: Spell Cascade
SupportSpellCascade.description: Supports spell skills that apply an effect to an area around a targeted location. Cannot support Vaal skills or skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

SupportAwakenedSpellCascade.name: Awakened Spell Cascade
SupportAwakenedSpellCascade.description: Supports spell skills that apply an effect to an area around a targeted location. Cannot support Vaal skills or skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

SupportSpellEcho.name: Spell Echo
SupportSpellEcho.description: Supports spell skills, making them repeat when cast. Cannot support Vaal skills, totem skills, channelling skills, triggered skills, instant skills, retaliation skills, blink skills, or skills with a reservation.

SupportAwakenedSpellEcho.name: Awakened Spell Echo
SupportAwakenedSpellEcho.description: Supports spell skills, making them repeat when cast. Cannot support Vaal skills, totem skills, channelling skills, triggered skills, instant skills, retaliation skills, blink skills, or skills with a reservation.

spell_echo_plus_chance_double_damage_%_f: mod("RepeatFinalDoubleDamageChance", "BASE", nil, ModFlag.Spell, 0, { type = "Condition", var = "CastOnFrostbolt", neg = true }, { type = "Condition", varList = {"averageRepeat", "alwaysFinalRepeat"} })

SupportSummonPhantasm.name: Summon Phantasm
SupportSummonPhantasm.description: Supports skills that can hit enemies, or create minions. When those skills or minions kill enemies, or hit rare or unique enemies they will have a chance to summon a Phantasm minion, which uses a piercing projectile spell that deals physical damage.

phantasm_minimum_added_physical_damage_t: mod("PhysicalMin", "BASE", nil, ModFlag.Spell, 0, { type = "PerStat", stat = "ActivePhantasmLimit" }, { type = "GlobalEffect", effectType = "Buff", effectName = "Phantasmal Might", effectCond = "PhantasmalMight", allowTotemBuff = true })
phantasm_maximum_added_physical_damage_t: mod("PhysicalMax", "BASE", nil, ModFlag.Spell, 0, { type = "PerStat", stat = "ActivePhantasmLimit" }, { type = "GlobalEffect", effectType = "Buff", effectName = "Phantasmal Might", effectCond = "PhantasmalMight", allowTotemBuff = true  })

SupportTrinity.name: Trinity
SupportTrinity.description: Supports skills that hit enemies, causing them to gain bonuses while you have resonance of all three elements, and to grant resonance of elements other than the highest one in a hit. There is a maximum of 50 Resonance for each Element. Cannot support triggered skills, instant skills, orb skills, brands, skills with a reservation, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

SupportUnboundAilments.name: Unbound Ailments
SupportUnboundAilments.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies or inflicts ailments

SupportAwakenedUnboundAilments.name: Awakened Unbound Ailments
SupportAwakenedUnboundAilments.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies or inflicts ailments

SupportUnleash.name: Unleash
SupportUnleash.description: Supports spell skills, making their effect reoccur when cast. Cannot support skills with cooldowns, triggered skills, Brand skills, Vaal skills, channelling skills, skills with a reservation, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

SupportAwakenedUnleash.name: Awakened Unleash
SupportAwakenedUnleash.description: Supports spell skills, making their effect reoccur when cast. Cannot support skills with cooldowns, triggered skills, Brand skills, Vaal skills, channelling skills, skills with a reservation, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
